commands: echo "RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-none} ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-none}"; git status --porcelain | head; echo "---base---"; .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/config-get.sh .base_branch main

for f in scripts/emit-git-env.sh scripts/apply-pr-triggerer.sh scripts/post-issue-comment.sh scripts/resolve-existing-pr.sh scripts/resolve-main-root.sh scripts/flip-review-progress-failed.sh scripts/apply-issue-dependencies.py lib/telemetry-branch.sh lib/fetch-pr-context.sh; do echo "== $f =="; grep -n 'apply-labels' "$f"; done

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
